errors.text: The proposed refractory HEA family is different from the target AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic FCC+B2 alloy.
The cited evidence reports simulated ordering, transport, or phonon behavior but no ductility measurements, crack initiation observations, or demonstrated ordering-induced embrittlement.

The mechanism substitutes generic SRO-driven intermetallic precipitation and dissolution for the target coupling of enhanced L12 order, elevated APBE, planar slip, and jagged FCC/B2 phase-boundary stress concentrations.

The proposed ODTT boundary is internally weak: cited Cr-Hf precipitation vanishes near 620 K, while the hypothesis uses an approximately 1120 K ODTT to define ductility recovery without evidence connecting either temperature to mechanical behavior.
